in_hebrew.name: יִגְעַדְנָא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יִגְדַד: to pour out, be bountiful; נָא: plea, supplication. God has poured out, has been bountiful in answer to supplication.

in_greek.name: Ἱερογενής
in_greek.long_meaning: ἱερός: holy; γένης: generation, offspring. One who is holy in generation or offspring.

in_latin.name: Caecilia
in_latin.long_meaning: Caecus: blind; lia: affliction. Hidden affliction, or one who is concealed or veiled in some way.
